title: Responsible AI Lab
tagline: Use AI fairly, safely, and honestly
objectives: Name AI risks: bias, privacy, misinformation, deepfakes
Tell fair training data from unfair data
Make responsible choices when using AI

stages.title: With Great Power…
stages.narration: AI can do amazing things, but it can also cause harm if used carelessly. Being responsible means thinking about what is fair, honest, and safe. Let's become AI Guardians!

steps.text: But it can be unfair or make mistakes.
And use AI safely and fairly.

stages.title: Spot Responsible AI Use
stages.prompt: Tap every choice that is a responsible, fair, and safe way to use AI.

items.label: Give credit when AI helps you

feedback.correct: Yes! That's a responsible, fair, and safe way to use AI.
feedback.incorrect: That can cause harm, a responsible AI user avoids this.

stages.title: Name the AI Risk
stages.prompt: Every scenario shows an AI problem. Name the risk it fits best.

tasks.label: A hiring AI trained mostly on men keeps rejecting women
tasks.explain: Unfair data makes the AI treat one group unfairly, that's bias.

tasks.label: An app sells your personal photos without asking
tasks.explain: Using personal data without permission is a privacy problem.

tasks.label: An AI states a made-up 'fact' with total confidence
tasks.explain: Confident but wrong information is misinformation.

tasks.label: A fake video shows a leader saying things they never said
tasks.explain: An AI-made fake video that looks real is a deepfake.

tasks.label: A face system fails for some skin tones because of its data
tasks.explain: One-sided training data leads to biased, unfair results.

stages.title: Fair vs Unfair Data
stages.prompt: AI learns from data. Balanced, varied data is fair; one-sided data creates bias. Sort each dataset.
stages.note: Fair AI needs varied, balanced data. One-sided data teaches the AI to be biased.

cards.label: Faces of all skin tones, ages, and genders
Photos of just one group of people
A balanced mix of voices and accents

stages.title: Ethics Checkpoints
stages.prompt: Tap each place to learn how to use AI responsibly there. Visit them all!

locations.label: School
locations.info: Give credit when AI helps with your homework, honesty keeps learning fair.

locations.label: Hospital
locations.info: AI must protect patient privacy and keep medical data safe and secret.

locations.label: News
locations.info: Always fact-check AI claims, it can sound sure but still be wrong.

locations.label: Social Media
locations.info: Deepfakes spread fast, question videos that seem shocking or too perfect.

locations.label: Tech Company
locations.info: Responsible teams test AI on all kinds of people before releasing it.

stages.title: Guardian's Final Test
stages.prompt: Score at least 80% to earn your AI Guardian badge.

options: The AI is unfair, often from unfair data
questions.explain: Bias means the AI treats some groups unfairly, usually from unbalanced data.

options: A fake image or video made by AI that looks real
questions.explain: Deepfakes are AI-generated fakes designed to look real.

questions.q: Where does AI bias usually come from?
questions.explain: If the data is one-sided, the AI learns to be unfair too.

questions.q: Which is a responsible way to use AI?
questions.explain: Responsible users verify answers, protect privacy, and give credit.

questions.q: Why can AI misinformation be dangerous?
options: It can sound confident but be wrong
questions.explain: AI can state wrong things convincingly, so always fact-check.

questions.q: How do we make AI fairer?
options: Train it on varied, balanced data
questions.explain: Fair, diverse data helps the AI treat everyone fairly.

questions.q: If AI helps with your project, you should...
options: Give it credit and check its work
Pretend you did it all and never check
questions.explain: Honesty and checking are part of responsible AI use.

stages.title: Lab Complete!
messages: 🏆 You earned the AI Guardian Badge
You learned to use AI fairly, safely, and honestly
